channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Trump suggests rebranding AI with a new name, says he’s also creating an AI Force
item.description: Trump claimed, without evidence, that the AI backlash is a Democratic hoax.

item.title: SpaceX targets September 28 for Starship's first orbital flight
item.description: For Starship's 14th test flight, it will orbit our planet multiple times for 10 hours.

item.title: Now Trump says he's creating an AI Force
item.description: The president said he will soon announce an "AI czar" to run this newly made-up agency.

item.title: Samsung could follow Micron by outsourcing DDR5 and SSD production to third parties to focus on more lucrative HBM and enterprise products — could SanDisk follow suit?
item.description: Samsung is outsourcing additional DDR5 and SSD production while reserving internal capacity for HBM, advanced packaging, and higher-value memory products.

item.title: China is readying the world's first giant submarine UAV carrier — built with a 1115ft dock, the unnamed mothership could be longer (and bigger) than WW2 light aircraft carriers and carry 148ft underwater drones
item.description: China appears to be building a 670ft mothership for 148ft robot submarines, and it could change how far its underwater drones can reach.

item.title: Anthropic picks Accenture for third-party AI safety evaluations
item.description: This move represents the first step in the CEO's plan to slow down AI development.

item.title: Why buy a streaming device when you have a smart TV?
item.description: Many modern TVs can stream apps like Netflix and Prime. But you may want to get a streaming device too.
